description:
Are you looking for a career that will make an impact?

 The Leidos Military and Veterans Health Solutions Operation has an opening for a Full Stack Software Engineer/Developer to join the Operational Readiness Directorate at the Naval Health Research Center in San Diego, CA. This position will support the Epidemiology and Data Management Support Department and involves programming, documenting, managing configuration, testing, and bug fixing involved in creating and maintaining applications and databases. This work will include collaborating with other software engineers/developers and researchers in the Department.

 Are you ready for unique and exciting work?

 This is a full-time position in San Diego with a hybrid work schedule (on-site and telework). The candidate for this position must be located within commuting distance of San Diego to work on-site at the Naval Health Research Center as needed. The number of days on-site may vary, and the schedule is subject to change based on program and customer requirements. Work hours will coincide with the standard command business hours of 0700-1630.

 Primary Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, and maintain applications and databases meeting technical, consumer, and customer needs
 Produce thorough documentation
 Simplify, modernize, and migrate legacy applications
 Coordinate with security teams to ensure architecture and software compliance
 Implement new features and bug fixes
 Work with QA engineers to test and deploy applications
 Work with product managers to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications
 Stay up-to-date on the latest technologies and trends in web, application, and database development
 Effectively communicate with peers, project leads, and the government customer in performance of program efforts.
 Work independently to achieve day-to-day objectives which impact operational results and project deliverables for the Operational Readiness Directorate and Force Health Analytics Department.
 Ensure tasks are completed on time for mission requirements.
 Assist other technical staff with tasks as needed for customer mission.
 Model Leidos Values at all times.
 
 If this sounds like an environment where you can thrive, keep reading for the keys to success!
 
 Basic Qualifications 

 We are looking for candidates who:
 Have completed a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited US university, or international university of equivalent standard, in computer science or a related field.
 Have at least 5 years of experience in full stack development.
 Demonstrate experience with at least one back-end programming language, such as Python, Java, PHP, C#.
 Demonstrate experience with at least one database, such as MSSQL, MySQL or PostgreSQL.
 Demonstrate experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs
 Demonstrate experience with version control systems, such as Gitlab.
 Demonstrate strong troubleshooting and debugging skills.
 Act on objectives in an independent manner and is a self-starter,
 Demonstrate excellent communication skills with all members of team and organization.
 Demonstrate excellent critical thinking and problem-solving skills and an ability to work cooperatively in a team setting. This includes flexibility in responding to changing demands, timelines, and priorities.
 Hold US Citizenship and are able to obtain and maintain a SECRET government security clearance.
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Familiarity with medical terms and electronic health record (EHR) systems
 Familiarity with the Risk Management Framework (RMF) Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) and related processes, such as the Authority to Operate (ATO)
 Have demonstrated experience with .NET Framework
 Have demonstrated experience with AWS or similar cloud computing platform
 Have demonstrated experience with DevOps
 Have demonstrated experience with security best practices
 Hold an active Interim or Secret security clearance
 


 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
 
 
 Original Posting: 
November 12, 2026 
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.







 
 
 Pay Range: 
Pay Range $87,100.00 - $157,450.00 
 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
